title: Document type of the project numbering system with its workflow rules (preparation, review, inputs, maturity)

dcc.description: IEC 61355-1 document kind class (main class letter)

review.description: Owner review class: approval (code 1 needed before IFC), review (comments), information, internal

prep_days.description: start of work to first issue (IFR / IFI)

update_days.description: incorporating comments to the next issue (IFA / IFC)

input_maturity.description: issue state the inputs must have reached before this document can start

input_types.description: document type codes that normally feed this type (checked on every document)

hours.description: default budget per document (per sheet for drawings)

construction.description: issued for construction: belongs to an EWP

procurement.description: part of an MR (specification, datasheet, requisition)

required_for.description: system categories for which every system needs a document of this type
